The Citadel's record calls the stitching an honour: a knight's word made flesh, never to be set down. The record was written by the surgeons, and it treats the question of whether the knights were asked as settled.

— Citadel surgeons' record
card.stitchedArms.name: Stitched Arms
card.stitchedArms.text: Deal {damage} damage to a random enemy, scaling with Energy spent.
card.stomp.flavor:
A heel brought down on a fallen enemy's chest, which the Wardens called unworthy and used regardless. Sellswords learned it in the Fell Courtyard, where the fallen seldom stayed down. They say the Wardens objected not to the blow but to being seen to deliver it. Several of the Bastion's older helms carry a heel-shaped dent, though whose heel is anyone's guess.

— sellswords' talk
card.stomp.name: Stomp
card.strike.flavor:
The first cut the hamlets teach, made with whatever edge the hamlet owns. Marl's Hollow sends one climber a winter, chosen by the elders at the well, and the one chosen spends the last evening at the whetting post learning this and nothing more. The elders say a Forsaken needs only the one cut, since the marked learned a thousand and it did them no good.

— Marl's Hollow elders
card.strike.name: Strike
card.sunderplate.flavor:
A blow meant to split plate at the joints. The book says the Wardens designed it during the Mark Trade with the Court's knights in mind, "in case the Court forgets which flame keeps it fed". It records no occasion on which it was used. The entry is kept all the same, beside a sketch of a knight's gorget with the Court's crest scratched out.

— Warden's field-book
card.sunderplate.name: Sunderplate
card.sunderplate.text: Deal {damage} damage and {poiseDamage} Poise damage. If the target is Staggered: apply {bleed} Bleed.
card.supernova.flavor:
The brightest working in the charts, and the last the Starwatch recorded. The Astronomer's final predictive chart forecasts a light strong enough to burn the paper it is drawn on. The Starwatch took it for a prediction about a star. The chart is unsigned and undated, and the apprentices who filed the series swore it was not among the sheets they left on his desk.

— Starwatch catalogue
card.supernova.name: Supernova
card.supernova.text: Deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies, scaling with Energy spent.
card.sweepingBlow.flavor:
A wide swing for the viaduct, where the corrupted come three abreast and the stone is narrow. The Forsaken councils teach that the viaducts were always built to funnel something, long before there were corrupted to funnel, and that the corrupted walk them now because the stone expects a crowd.

— Forsaken council teaching
card.sweepingBlow.name: Sweeping Blow
card.technique.flavor:
Steps cut into the road by those who came before, and the way of moving that goes with them. The steps are too even to be natural and too worn to be recent. Climbers credit them to the Forsaken. They run on past the farthest point any Forsaken is known to have reached, and some lead out onto the viaducts, which are older than the kingdom.

Climbers before you cut steps. Use them.
— cairn-scratch
card.technique.name: Footwork
card.thornHaloCard.flavor:
A crown of briar worn by the Saints on the feast of the Founding, in memory of the first Saint, who by Chapel tradition wore thorns in the caldera. The Chapel held that each thorn stood for a name the Saint carried. The Thorn Matriarch of the Briar Sanctum grew her own crown in the Long Winter, and the remnant counts her a Saint, though she was a Warden and never swore to the Chapel.

— Chapel remnant calendar
card.thornHaloCard.name: Thorn Halo
card.thornHaloCard.text: At the start of your turn, apply 1 Crimson Blight to ALL enemies.
card.thousandCutsRogue.flavor:
Many small cuts, each one undoing a stitch. The Court's surgeons called unstitching the procedure run backward and forbade it, since a courtier sewn to his post had taken an oath. Dock folk say a surgeon was caught unstitching his own wife from the palace stair the winter after the Burning. The surgeons' day-book records only that a stitching failed.

— east bank dock talk
card.thousandCutsRogue.name: Thousand Cuts
card.thousandCutsRogue.text: Deal {damage} damage {hits} times. Prepared: deal {damage.2} damage {hits.2} times. Consume Prepared.
card.timeDilation.flavor:
A slowing of the moment, named for the night of the eclipse. By the Starwatch's reckoning the eclipse lasted one night. By the Observatory clock it has not ended. Anselm, who kept the clock, refused to reset it and was found beside it when the others came up, in the position he had held when the light went. The clock has not been reset.

— Starwatch log
card.timeDilation.name: Time Dilation
card.toxicVolley.flavor:
Vials of the surgeons' sedative broken into the river fog upwind of the bridge watch. Dock folk say the river smelled of it for weeks and the watch slept through three robberies. The watch ledger records the same three weeks as quiet, and commends the men for their vigilance.

— east bank dock talk
card.toxicVolley.name: Toxic Volley
card.toxicVolley.text: Apply {venom} Venom and {weak} Weak to ALL enemies.
card.transfusion.flavor:
Blood poured from one cup into another and called communion, a rite the Saints performed between themselves and the dying of good family. The rubric describes the Saint as giving and says nothing of receiving. Novice Wen wrote that the flow went both ways, and that the Saints came out of the rite looking younger. She does not say who told her so.

— novice's confession
card.transfusion.name: Transfusion
card.transmute.flavor:
A cinder spent in the palm before it cools, and for a moment the hand that holds it does not shake. The hamlets hold that each cinder was someone once, and the Forsaken who spend them do not like to be reminded. There is a rule in the hamlets against spending a cinder you took yourself. Climbers who come back down from the ring have usually broken it.

— hamlet council minute
card.transmute.name: Transmute
card.twinFang.flavor:
Two knives worn crosswise, one for the hound and one for its handler. The weald's blight-hounds belonged to the Wardens before the Burning, and they run with handlers still: kennelmen of the Bastion who turned with the pack and walk behind it. Hamlet folk say a handler can be reasoned with, briefly. They do not advise trying twice.

— weald hamlet saying
card.twinFang.name: Twin Fang
card.twinPrick.flavor:
Two small punctures close together, which the Court's surgeons entered as bites when they found them on bodies along the bridges. Their receipts note the hour, the bridge and the fee for the inquest, and not one case closed. The dock children who did the work call the mark the Surgeon's Signature, and consider the name a compliment the surgeons earned.

— dock children's talk
card.twinPrick.name: Twin Prick
card.twinPrick.text: Deal {damage} damage {hits} times. Prepared: deal {damage.2} damage {hits.2} times. Consume Prepared.
card.twinbladeFlurry.flavor:
Two short blades worked in turn, the habit of weald sellswords who could not afford a shield and would not carry a Warden's. The Bastion hired them for its narrow gates. Sellswords say part of their pay came as a mark on the wrist in place of coin, a right to the city's warmth. Those who took it are not around to confirm the story. Those who refused tell it often.

— sellswords' talk
card.twinbladeFlurry.name: Twinblade Flurry
card.twinkling.flavor:
A small light drawn from a star that varies. The Astronomer recorded its variation nightly for many years and drew no conclusion from it, which he described as his rule. His apprentices said he broke the rule once, in the last spring before the Burning, when he spent three nights on that star alone. The charts for those nights are not in the series.

— apprentice's letter
card.twinkling.name: Twinkling
card.umbralWard.flavor:
A ward of shadow cast from starstone, named for the eclipse, during which the Observatory cast no shadow at all. The Starwatch recorded the absence as a curiosity of the light. The apprentices on the terrace that night reported that they cast shadows as usual, but that their shadows fell toward the Observatory rather than away from it.

— Starwatch log
card.umbralWard.name: Umbral Ward
card.unbreakable.flavor:
The order to hold the Fell Courtyard gate until relieved, as it stands in the gate log: dated, signed, and never countermanded. The entries go on past the Burning in the second hand, at the same hour each night. Who relieved the writer, or whether anyone came to, the log does not record.

— Fell Courtyard gate log
card.unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
card.unbreakable.text: Block no longer expires at the start of your turn. (Block capped at 30.)
card.urgentHeal.flavor:
The Chapel's rite for a wound taken in its service, done quickly, with the prayer cut to its first line. The rubric instructs the officiant to bind the wound beneath the brand and never over it, so the mark is left clear. The Chapel's physicians held this to be sound medicine. The rubric gives no medical reason.

We bind the wound beneath the unspent brand.
— Chapel rubric
card.urgentHeal.name: Urgent Heal
card.vanish.flavor:
Under the bridges there is nothing but ice, if anyone asks, and the docks have made an art of being part of that nothing. The trick is older than the Burning. Dock folk say it was taught to them by the unmarked who lived beneath the bridges before the Decree, when being seen meant being entered on a roll. Most of those teachers did vanish, in the end. The docks do not agree on where to.

— east bank dock talk
card.vanish.name: Vanish
card.vanish.text: Gain {block} Block. Become Prepared. Add a Smoke Pellet to your hand. Exhaust.
card.venomcoat.flavor:
A paste the Court's surgeons sold by the vial as a sedative for courtiers who could not sleep in the weeks before the Decree. The docks found it worked on a blade as well as it worked in wine. The label promises a dreamless night in gilt letters, and the docks peel it off before selling the vial on.

— surgeons' vial label, dock copy
card.venomcoat.name: Venomcoat
card.vesperWard.flavor:
A ward carried by the Chapel's evening bell-ringers, who rang a chime at vespers to close the day. The bell was taken out of it long ago, leaving only the frame and the ward. Climbers who carry it say it rings at dusk anyway. The Chapel remnant would call that a miracle, if anyone told them.

A Chapel ward, rung at vespers. The bell is gone.
— cairn-scratch
card.vesperWard.name: Vesper Ward
card.warSurgeon.flavor:
The field practice of the Bastion's surgeon-wardens, who stitched wounds on the wall rather than below it. Their rule was that a Warden stitched standing remained a Warden, and one carried down to the stool was struck from the roll. The book credits them with a better record than the Chapel's physicians. The Chapel's own figures for those years burned with the Chapel.

— Warden's field-book
card.warSurgeon.name: War Surgeon
card.warSurgeon.text: Heal 2 HP for every 4 Bleed on all enemies. Exhaust.
card.warcry.flavor:
The bell-roll shouted aloud where the bell could not be heard, a custom of the gates farthest from the Bellfoundry. The Wardens held that the roll had a power of its own, so long as it was read in order. Sellswords, who were not on it, learned to shout it anyway. The Bell Keeper is said to answer when he hears it, with the bell, which is cracked.

— Bastion bell-roll, marginal note
card.warcry.name: Warcry
card.wardingLunge.flavor:
A guarded step forward that ends in the breaking stance, taught as the moment to stop holding and start taking ground. The book says a Warden should know the moment by the bell. After the Bellfoundry bell cracked, a new line was added beneath: know it by the smell of the courtyard. What that smell is supposed to be, the entry leaves to the reader.

— Warden's field-book
card.wardingLunge.name: Warding Lunge
card.wardingStar.flavor:
A guarding light fixed above the one who works it, named for the star the apprentices called the Fixed Lamp, which hung over the coast and did not move with the others. The Starwatch took it for a flaw in the lens and reground the lens twice. The star stayed where it was. Once the Spire was finished, the log stops using the name and refers to it only as "the error".

— Starwatch log
card.wardingStar.name: Warding Star
card.warmLitany.flavor:
The first prayer a novice of the Furnace Chapel learned, said over a small hurt to keep it warm. Novices were told the words were older than the Chapel itself, and that the first Saint had found them cut into the caldera wall. The last novice says it daily, over wounds that are not always small.

We give the name. We keep the warmth.
— Chapel remnant
card.warmLitany.name: Warm Litany
card.warriorsVow.flavor:
The contract read to sellswords hired for the Fell Courtyard: hold the gate until relieved, pay in advance. Weald sellswords treated a paid contract as sacred, having few other sacred things, and the Wardens thought them mercenary for it. The last contract on the roll was signed the week before the Burning. The space for the date of release is blank.

— Bastion hiring roll
card.warriorsVow.name: Warrior's Vow
card.waxingMoonCard.flavor:
A working that grows night by night, named for the moon-table the Starwatch kept alongside its ember-tables. In the last decade before the Burning the two tables moved in step: each night the moon grew, the coal in the Crown dimmed by the same measure. The Astronomer noted the correspondence, called it coincidence, and stopped keeping the moon-table.

— Starwatch tables
card.waxingMoonCard.name: Waxing Moon
card.waxingMoonCard.text: At the start of your turn, apply 2 Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
card.witheringTouch.flavor:
A touch that withers growth, which the rubric permits on weeds in the weald's field-shrines and on nothing else. The permission was revised in the years the Field Flame dimmed, to add a clause forbidding the touch on crops. The clause is dated after three harvests had already failed, and it is signed by a Saint whose name does not appear in the roll of Saints.

— Chapel rubric
card.witheringTouch.name: Withering Touch
card.wound.flavor:
A cut that has closed wrong, knitting into a hard ridge that aches before the weather turns. Climbers call it the road keeping its share. The hamlets have an older word for it that means owed, and they do not say to whom.

— told at the Grave of the Nameless
card.wound.name: Wound
card.zealotryCard.flavor:
We teach that each wound is a door the fire walks through, and we bless wounds instead of binding them. The Chapel knew this and hid it behind a ledger, so that the fire would come only to those it had promised. We promise nothing. Our converts do not live long. We bury them under antlers and wax at the shrine, and more come every week.

— Feral Ember sermon
card.zealotryCard.name: Zealotry
card.zealotryCard.text: Whenever you lose HP, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
class.herald.description: Spends its own health to act, then heals it back. Spreads a rot that damages enemies over time. One pool for everything, so mistakes stack up fast.
class.herald.name: Herald
class.reaver.description: Fights up close and switches footing mid-battle — one stance hits harder, the other holds the line. Wounds you land keep bleeding, and heavy blows stagger.
class.reaver.name: Reaver
class.rogue.description: Sets up a clean opening, then turns speed, poison, and opportunism into decisive strikes before the enemy can recover.
class.rogue.name: Rogue
class.starseer.description: Casts in sequence — the second spell each turn strikes harder than the first. Fragile early on, so the order you play cards matters more than their power.

event.abandonedCart.name: Abandoned Merchant Cart
event.abandonedCart.text: A trader’s cart lies tipped in the mud, one wheel still turning. Cinder-light glints from a split strongbox. The mud around it is churned with bootprints.
event.ancientRuneStone.name: Ancient Cinder Stone
event.ancientRuneStone.text: A standing stone hums with old script. Reading it makes your teeth ache and your hands steadier. It would also break beautifully.
event.bloodstainedAltar.name: Bloodstained Altar
event.bloodstainedAltar.text: An altar of dark stone, its channels worn smooth by use. The instructions are carved plainly: the stone sharpens what is given to it, and it keeps a portion.
event.cinderbearDen.name: Cinderbear Den
event.cinderbearDen.text: The cave reeks of musk and old kills. Cinder-light glitters in the bone-litter at the back — a fortune, if you are quiet, and quick, and the mound of fur by the wall keeps breathing slow.
event.discardedReliquary.name: Discarded Reliquary
event.discardedReliquary.text: A traveler's pack lies split open at the trail's edge, its owner nowhere to be found. Among the ruined provisions, a single card sits face-down, deliberately placed — as though left as a warning, not a gift.
event.fadedGrace.name: Seat of Faded Emberlight
event.fadedGrace.text: A guiding ember once pooled here, now guttering to a thread of gold. It has just enough left to give — a mending, or a sharpening — but not both, and not for long.
event.feralShrine.name: Shrine of the Feral Ember
event.feralShrine.text: A shrine no church would recognize: antlers, wax, and old blood. Ember pools here anyway — wild, unattended, and guarded by something that has not left claw marks this fresh by accident.
event.goldboughAvatar.name: Goldbough Avatar
event.goldboughAvatar.text: A hulking avatar kneels in a clearing, grown into the roots of a golden sapling. It does not attack. It holds out one massive hand, palm up, waiting.
event.goldenMoth.name: Golden Moth
event.goldenMoth.text: A moth the size of a shield rests on a broken pillar, wings dusted with cinder-light. It is dying, slowly and without complaint. Cinders drip from its wings like pollen.
event.graveOfTheNameless.name: Grave of the Nameless
event.graveOfTheNameless.text:
A cairn of broken swords marks a grave no one tends. Cinder-light seeps between the blades like frost.

The mound is quiet — the particular quiet of something that could stop being quiet.
event.handspiderNest.name: Handspider Nest
event.handspiderNest.text: A cluster of pale, many-jointed hands scuttles in the dark ahead, nested around a strongbox they have dragged from somewhere below. They have not noticed you. Yet.
event.lanternCaravan.name: The Caravan Comes Through
event.lanternCaravan.text:
The Road Warden stands beside Lantern Haven’s mud-spattered wagons. The last one carries the lantern you helped raise.

"You bought these people a road. We can pay our debt. That strongbox is for medicine at the next trading post; it belongs to the cold hamlets."
event.lastLantern.name: The Last Lantern
event.lastLantern.text:
An unmarked routekeeper braces a broken signal lantern against the rain. The drivers call this traveler the Road Warden; there is no Fell Courtyard crest on the coat.

"That caravan carries medicine to Lantern Haven and the cold hamlets beyond. Oil costs forty cinders. Or help me haul the spare beacon up the scree."
event.merchantsGhost.name: Merchant's Ghost
event.merchantsGhost.text: A translucent figure keeps a stall that is no longer there, weighing wares no living hand can hold. "Custom," it sighs, almost grateful. "It has been so long. I have something you'll want."
event.namelessKeeper.name: The Keeper of the Nameless
event.namelessKeeper.text:
A figure in grave-clothes waits at a fork in the road, a lantern of cinder-light held low.

It knows the cairn of broken swords. It knows what you did there. It has been walking since.
event.namelessRest.name: The Second Cairn
event.namelessRest.text:
Beside the road stands a second cairn. Its swords have fallen into the mud; no names are carved on its stones.

The keeper is not here. The road continues beyond it, and you cannot tell which way the keeper went.
event.omensAltar.name: Warden's Altar
event.omensAltar.text: An altar carved with a face too many-eyed to be a saint. A voice — or something like one — offers to lend you its strength, if you will let it watch through your eyes for the rest of the road.
event.rotPriestOffer.name: Blight-Priest's Offer
event.rotPriestOffer.text: A priest kneels in a ring of dead grass, robes fused to weeping skin. He is unbothered, almost radiant. "The Blight gives," he says, holding out a reliquary in one ruined hand. "It asks only a little flesh in return."
event.sleepingSmith.name: Sleeping Smith
event.sleepingSmith.text: A smith slumps over his anvil, hammer still loose in one hand. His forge is cold, but the blade laid across it hums like it remembers heat. He does not stir when you approach.
event.stakeOfTheMartyr.name: Stake of the Martyr
event.stakeOfTheMartyr.text: A stake of gilded thorn juts from the path, humming with the promise of return. It asks for a piece of you to hold in trust — a card, and a measure of your vigor — and offers a relic drawn up from where the dead wait.
event.turncoatMirror.name: The Turncoat's Mirror
event.turncoatMirror.text: A standing mirror in a ruined chapel, its silver gone to smoke. In it you are someone else: the same hands, the same scars, another calling. It waits to see whether you will step through.
event.twoFingersRiddle.name: The Oracle's Riddle
event.twoFingersRiddle.text: A pair of enormous fingers rises from a font of still water, tapping a slow rhythm only they understand. Read one way, the rhythm sharpens the mind. Read another, it mends the flesh — but the second reading leaves a mark.
event.wanderingPhysician.name: Wandering Physician
event.wanderingPhysician.text: A physician in a rain-rotted coat unrolls his instruments without being asked. "I can cut something out of you," he says. "The procedure is not painless. Or I can simply patch you."
event.weepingPilgrim.name: Wayward Pilgrim
event.weepingPilgrim.text: A pilgrim sits at the roadside, robes soaked through, cradling something wrapped in cloth. "Fifty cinders," she says, without looking up. "It was my sister’s. I can’t carry it further."
event.wyrmTrial.name: Wyrm Trial
event.wyrmTrial.text: A cracked stone ring marks a trial-ground no map names. A single soldier stands within it, unmoving, waiting for someone foolish or hungry enough to step inside.

relic.bloodstainedChalice.flavor: It fills a little more each time. You have stopped asking with what.

relic.carrionMorsel.flavor: The spire feeds those who feed it. It is not fussy about the manners of the exchange.

relic.crimsonCovenant.flavor: The pact is simple: your blood answers for theirs. It is not a fair trade, but it is fast.

relic.crownOfStitches.flavor: It fits. That is the worst part.
relic.crownOfStitches.name: Crown of Stitches
relic.crownOfStitches.text: Begin each combat with {strength} Strength — and {frail} Frail. New limbs are heavy.
relic.curedHide.flavor: The beast learned its lesson too late to keep it.
relic.curedHide.name: Cured Hide
relic.curedHide.text: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {block} Block. Poise threshold +2 (no current consumer).
relic.cutpursesCoin.flavor: One face buys silence. The other buys speed.
relic.cutpursesCoin.name: Cutpurse's Coin
relic.cutpursesCoin.text: Begin each combat Prepared. Your first attack each combat applies {venom} Venom.
relic.emberFragment.name: Ember Fragment
relic.emberIdol.flavor: It has been warm to the touch for a thousand years. It is patient about it.
relic.emberIdol.name: Ember Idol
relic.emberIdol.text: At the start of each turn, deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies.
relic.emberwickCharm.flavor: It burns brightest at the moment you can least afford to slow down.
relic.emberwickCharm.name: Emberwick Charm
relic.emberwickCharm.text: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {gainEnergy} Energy.
relic.fellWardenBrand.name: Fell Warden Brand
relic.fellWardenBrand.text: Whenever an enemy Staggers, draw {draw} cards.
relic.feralEye.name: Feral Eye
relic.feralEye.text: Elites offer an extra card reward choice.
relic.flayersCenser.flavor: The smoke seeks out lungs. It is not particular about whose.
relic.flayersCenser.name: Flayer's Censer
relic.flayersCenser.text: At the start of each turn, apply {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight to ALL enemies.
relic.forsakenMedallion.flavor: Its face is worn smooth, but it still remembers being gold.
relic.forsakenMedallion.name: Forsaken Medallion
relic.forsakenMedallion.text: Max HP +{hpFlat}. Your first attack each combat also deals {poiseDamage} Poise damage.
relic.forsakenWarflag.flavor: The colors are all but rotted away. What it musters now answers to no banner but yours.
relic.forsakenWarflag.name: Forsaken Warflag
relic.forsakenWarflag.text: At the start of each turn, apply {weak} Weak to ALL enemies.
relic.gildedTear.flavor: A single drop, hardened gold, wept for someone who never asked for it.
relic.gildedTear.name: Gilded Tear
relic.gildedTear.text: On your first turn each combat, heal {heal} HP.
relic.goldFigurine.flavor: It is very small and very heavy and it loves you.
relic.goldFigurine.name: Gold Figurine
relic.goldFigurine.text: Whenever you heal, gain {block} Block (even at full HP).
relic.goldboughSapling.name: Goldbough Sapling
relic.goldboughSapling.text: At the start of your turn, if you have no Block: gain {block} Block.
relic.goldenSprout.flavor: A sapling waits inside, patient as grief.
relic.goldenSprout.name: Golden Sprout
relic.goldenSprout.text: At the start of each combat, heal {heal} HP.
relic.goldleafCharm.flavor: A single leaf, pressed flat, still gold. It keeps the wind off you.
relic.goldleafCharm.name: Goldleaf Charm
relic.goldleafCharm.text: At the start of your first turn, gain {block} Block.
relic.gravetendersBell.flavor: One toll for each name laid down. The tending is in the counting.
relic.gravetendersBell.name: Gravetender's Bell
relic.gravetendersBell.text: Whenever an enemy dies, draw {draw} card.
relic.hollowedHorn.flavor: It sounds only once. Everything still standing flinches.
relic.hollowedHorn.name: Hollowed Horn
relic.hollowedHorn.text: Whenever an enemy Staggers, apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
relic.howlingStandard.flavor: It has not fallen in a hundred routs. It does not intend to start with yours.
relic.howlingStandard.name: Howling Standard
relic.howlingStandard.text: Whenever an enemy Staggers, gain {strength} Strength.
relic.ivoryComb.flavor: Someone kept themselves tidy right up until the end.
relic.ivoryComb.name: Ivory Comb
relic.ivoryComb.text: Every 8th card you play each combat: draw {draw} card.
relic.kindlingCharm.name: Kindling Charm
relic.kindlingCharm.text: At the start of each combat, draw {draw} extra card.
relic.lodestarShard.flavor: It points nowhere on any map. It points at the next cast.
relic.lodestarShard.name: Lodestar Shard
relic.lodestarShard.text: Begin each combat with {restoreMana} extra Mana.
relic.moonlitVial.flavor: It never empties. It never fills, either.
relic.moonlitVial.name: Moonlit Vial
relic.moonlitVial.text: At the start of each combat, gain {block} Block.
relic.paupersDiadem.flavor: The crown accepts your future earnings. It never asks what you will eat.
relic.paupersDiadem.name: Pauper's Diadem
relic.paupersDiadem.text: Power cards cost 1 less (minimum 0). Gain 35% fewer Cinders from combats.
relic.pearlOfSagacity.flavor: It clouds when you are foolish. It has been cloudy for some time.
relic.pearlOfSagacity.name: Pearl of Sagacity
relic.pearlOfSagacity.text: Every 6th card you play each combat: gain {gainEnergy} Energy.
relic.prismaticThorn.flavor: It drinks the medicine and leaves the fever bright.
relic.prismaticThorn.name: Prismatic Thorn
relic.prismaticThorn.text: Your hits build 25% more Arcane Exposure. Flasks are 25% weaker (rounded up).
relic.radiantAegis.flavor: It rewards the guarded. It has nothing to say to the reckless.
relic.radiantAegis.name: Radiant Aegis
relic.radiantAegis.text: At the start of each turn, if you have Block: gain {block} Block.
relic.restlessClasp.flavor: It keeps the medicine close and sleep far away.
relic.restlessClasp.name: Restless Clasp
relic.restlessClasp.text: Flasks are 100% stronger. Resting heals 50% less.
relic.sacrificialKnife.flavor: It was made to open things that were meant to stay closed.
relic.sacrificialKnife.name: Sacrificial Knife
relic.sacrificialKnife.text: Your first attack each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.
relic.saltedRelic.flavor: It was buried to keep something in, or something out. No one remembers which.
relic.saltedRelic.name: Salted Relic
relic.sealstoneKey.name: Sealstone Key
relic.sealstoneKey.text: Unknown (?) locations on the map are revealed.
relic.sentinelsOath.flavor: The oath is long and the watch is longer. Endurance is its own kind of edge.
relic.sentinelsOath.name: Sentinel's Oath
relic.sentinelsOath.text: Every 12th card you play each combat: gain {strength} Strength.
relic.starstoneShard.flavor: A chip of someone else’s genius. It still hums.
relic.starstoneShard.name: Starstone Shard
relic.starstoneShard.text: Mana +{manaFlat}. Magic damage +{magicDamageFlat}. Begin each combat with Starstone Charge and restore {restoreMana} Mana.
relic.titansCinder.flavor: A giant died to make this. It is still furious about it.
relic.titansCinder.name: Titan's Cinder
relic.titansCinder.text: At the start of each turn, gain {strength} Strength.
relic.travelersWhetstone.flavor: It was sharpened by hands that are no longer here to use it.
relic.travelersWhetstone.name: Traveler's Whetstone
relic.travelersWhetstone.text: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
relic.twinnedArmor.name: Twinned Armor
relic.twinnedArmor.text: Every 10th card you play each combat: gain {block} Block.
relic.vigilantHalo.flavor: It hovers a hand above your head, waiting for you to earn it.
relic.vigilantHalo.name: Vigilant Halo
relic.vigilantHalo.text: Whenever an enemy Staggers, heal {heal} HP.
relic.vowOfVengeance.flavor: Every name you take is a name you carry.
relic.vowOfVengeance.name: Vow of Vengeance
relic.vowOfVengeance.text: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {strength} Strength.
relic.wardenHorn.flavor: It sounds without being blown. Something is answering.
relic.wardenHorn.name: Warden Horn
relic.wardenHorn.text: Draw {draw} extra card each turn. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.
relic.wardensLantern.flavor: The flame gutters when you are hurt, then burns a little brighter.
relic.wardensLantern.name: Warden's Lantern
relic.wardensLantern.text: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw {draw} card.
relic.warhorn.flavor: One long note, and the old anger answers.
relic.warhorn.name: Warhorn
relic.warhorn.text: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
relic.watchmansBadge.flavor: It is pinned to a coat that has seen more watches than the man wearing it.
relic.watchmansBadge.name: Watchman's Badge
relic.watchmansBadge.text: At the start of each turn, if you are not Weak: gain {strength} Strength.
relic.waxenSeal.flavor: Pressed once, it holds. Pressed twice, it is only wax.
relic.waxenSeal.name: Waxen Seal
relic.waxenSeal.text: The first time you heal each combat, heal {heal} more.
relic.wayfarersKnot.flavor: One knot for the road ahead. One for the breath to walk it.
relic.wayfarersKnot.name: Wayfarer's Knot
relic.wayfarersKnot.text: Gain 10% more Cinders from combats. Resting heals 10% more.
relic.whetstoneFragment.name: Whetstone Fragment
relic.whetstoneFragment.text: Your first attack each combat deals {damage} extra damage.
relic.whetstonePouch.flavor: A thumb along the edge before the first cut. Habit, and then not.
relic.whetstonePouch.name: Whetstone Pouch
relic.whetstonePouch.text: Your first attack while Prepared each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.
relic.wrathCoil.flavor: It winds tighter with every wound and lets go all at once, at someone else.
relic.wrathCoil.name: Wrath Coil
relic.wrathCoil.text: Whenever you lose HP, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.
relic.wyrmHeart.flavor: It still beats. It expects something of you.
relic.wyrmHeart.name: Wyrm Heart
relic.wyrmHeart.text: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Energy each turn. Shrines and chapels no longer offer Rest.

status.astromancer.name: Astromancer
status.astromancer.tooltip: At the start of your turn, gain Starstone Charge and draw a card.
status.azureCoil.name: Azure Coil
status.azureCoil.tooltip: Whenever you play a Skill, gain 2 Block per stack.

status.bloodUnction.name: Blood Unction
status.bloodUnction.tooltip: Your attacks apply 2 extra Bleed per hit this turn.
status.bulwarkEcho.name: Shieldwall Echo
status.bulwarkEcho.tooltip: At the start of your next turn: gain 4 Block per stack.

status.burn.tooltip: At the start of its turn, loses HP equal to Burn stacks (ignores Block). One stack burns out each turn.
status.communion.name: Communion
status.communion.tooltip: At the start of your turn, heal 3 HP per stack.
status.constellation.name: Constellation
status.constellation.tooltip: Whenever you gain Starstone Charge, deal 4 damage per stack to a random enemy.
status.crimsonBlight.name: Crimson Blight

status.deadlyTempo.name: Deadly Tempo
status.deadlyTempo.tooltip: At turn start, become Prepared and draw 1 card per stack.
status.dexterity.name: Dexterity

status.emberTide.tooltip: Whenever you heal, gain 1 Strength per stack.
status.envenom.name: Envenom
status.envenom.tooltip: Your attacks apply 1 Venom per stack.
status.frail.name: Frail
status.frail.tooltip: Gains 25% less Block from cards. 1 stack expires each turn.
status.frost.name: Frost
status.frost.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, and the target is left Weak and Frost-Exposed — then the build-up resets to zero.
status.frostExposed.name: Frost-Exposed
status.frostExposed.tooltip: Takes {tv.pct}% more damage from starstone attacks. Stacks with Vulnerable. {decay.duration} turns.
status.frostResist.name: Weathered
status.frostResist.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Frost: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.
status.glassCannon.name: Glass Cannon
status.glassCannon.tooltip: Deal 25% more attack damage, and take 25% more.
status.goreblood.name: Goreblood
status.goreblood.tooltip: Poise thresholds no longer increase after filling.
status.harbingerOfBlight.name: Harbinger of Blight
status.harbingerOfBlight.tooltip: Whenever you apply Crimson Blight to an enemy, heal 1 HP per stack.
status.insanity.name: Insanity
status.insanity.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, with {proc.poiseDamage} Poise damage and a guaranteed Stagger — then the build-up resets to zero.
status.insanityExposed.name: Unraveled
status.insanityExposed.tooltip: Takes {tv.pct}% more damage from ritual and blight attacks. Stacks with Vulnerable. {decay.duration} turns.
status.insanityResist.name: Resolute
status.insanityResist.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Insanity: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.
status.ironVow.name: Iron Vow
status.ironVow.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, gain 3 Block per stack.
status.lifeTithe.name: Life Tithe
status.lifeTithe.tooltip: Whenever an enemy dies, heal 8 HP per stack.
status.madness.name: Madness
status.madness.tooltip: At the start of your turn: lose 2 HP per stack, gain 1 Energy per stack, then Madness clears.
status.magicVulnerable.name: Magic Vulnerable
status.magicVulnerable.tooltip: Magic-school HP damage is increased while this lasts. Arcane Exposure buildup is locked.
status.moonlitShield.name: Moonlit Shield
status.moonlitShield.tooltip: Whenever you gain Starstone Charge, gain 3 Block per stack.
status.opportunist.name: Opportunist
status.opportunist.tooltip: When an enemy staggers, become Prepared and draw 1 card per stack.
status.prepared.name: Prepared
status.prepared.tooltip: Your next setup payoff is empowered. Expires at turn end.
status.rallyingStandard.name: Rallying Standard
status.rallyingStandard.tooltip: At the start of your turn: gain 1 Strength and take 1 damage (per stack).
status.rallyingStandardUp.name: Rallying Standard+
status.rallyingStandardUp.tooltip: At the start of your turn: gain 1 Strength (per stack).
status.regen.name: Regen
status.regen.tooltip: At the start of its turn, heals HP equal to Regen stacks. Lasts the whole fight.
status.sanguinePact.name: Sanguine Pact
status.sanguinePact.tooltip: Whenever Bleed bursts on an enemy, gain 2 Strength per stack.
status.staggered.name: Staggered

status.stargazer.name: Stargazer
status.stargazer.tooltip: At the start of your turn, gain Starstone Charge.
status.starstoneCharge.name: Starstone Charge
status.starstoneCharge.tooltip: A spell was cast this turn: your next Starstone bonus is live. Fades at end of turn.
status.stigmata.name: Stigmata
status.stigmata.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, heal 2 HP per stack.
status.strength.name: Strength
status.thornHalo.name: Thorn Halo
status.thornHalo.tooltip: At the start of your turn, apply 1 Crimson Blight per stack to ALL enemies.
status.unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
status.unbreakable.tooltip: Block no longer expires at the start of your turn. Block is capped at 30.
status.unbreakableUp.name: Unbreakable+
status.unbreakableUp.tooltip: Block no longer expires at the start of your turn. Block is capped at 40.
status.venom.name: Venom
status.venom.tooltip: At turn start, lose HP equal to Venom. 1 stack expires each turn.
status.vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
status.vulnerable.tooltip: Takes 50% more attack damage. 1 stack expires each turn.
status.waxingMoon.name: Waxing Moon
status.waxingMoon.tooltip: At the start of your turn, apply 2 Vulnerable to ALL enemies per stack.

status.zealotry.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, deal 3 damage to a random enemy per stack.
